description: For distinct atoms \(a\) and \(b\), the valuation true exactly at \(a\) and \(b\) satisfies \(a\to b\) and atom \(b\), while it falsifies \(\neg a\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.affirmingConsequent_neg_countervaluation.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (a b : α) (_hab : a ≠ b) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Countervaluation (fun c => if c = a ∨ c = b then true else false)
    {(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom a).impl
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom b),
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom b}
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.atom a).neg
